The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its head is visible facing left, showing small dark eyes and smooth skin. The body curves towards the right, partially obscured by a large brown leaf in the foreground. The tail extends towards the bottom right. The lighting highlights the wet, reflective texture of the salamander's skin.
